name: Media Ledger
tagline: A running ledger of the books, games, films and albums you own, straight from receipts
description: It goes through your inbox for purchase confirmations and builds one ledger of every digital thing you already own, from ebooks and audiobooks to games, films and albums. Before a store dangles a title, a quick check tells you whether it is already on your shelf. No more paying twice for a book you forgot.
author: phillipstewart
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
